findings.summary: The selected scanner admits only value-checked, inert worksheet metadata: sheetViews/sheetView/selection, sheetFormatPr, style-free cols/col records, row spans, pageMargins, and the bounded pageSetup subset.
semantic_guards: Unknown attributes, duplicate attributes, invalid lexical values, invalid ranges, duplicate or out-of-order containers, styled columns, and unsupported child structure refuse the selected route.

Column intervals are strictly ordered and non-overlapping; page margins, page setup values, selection references, row spans, sheet view counts, and SpreadsheetML/x14ac/relationship namespaces are bounded and validated.
The selected route does not materialize layout, view, print, or column metadata, so accepted records are admitted only where those values cannot change selected cell values.

findings.summary: Unsupported, opaque, repairable, ambiguous, malformed-semantic, styled, duplicate, or out-of-order metadata marks the scanner NotEligible and falls through to the authoritative worksheet parser; malformed XML and authoritative stream failures remain typed errors.
semantic_guards: Opaque MCE content, general references and CDATA in metadata, unknown namespaces, unsupported children, and style-bearing columns cannot be skipped to reach sheetData.
The ordinary worksheet parser remains the fallback owner for metadata it can repair or materialize, including page setup semantics outside the bounded projection.
Malformed recognized metadata is refused as a route decision where projection is unsafe; parser, XML, MCE, cancellation, and source failures are propagated as their existing typed errors.
evidence: metadata eligibility and invalid-value cases in crates/litchi-xlsx/src/raw/worksheet/selected/producer_metadata_tests.rs
authoritative fallback and full-cell selector coverage in tools/perf-baseline/src/producer_shape/selected_route_tests.rs

findings.summary: New metadata admission is gated by declared input size against the authoritative stream ceilings, so a newly admitted metadata barrier cannot introduce a stricter late stream failure than the baseline path; pre-barrier typed failures remain errors.
proof_conditions: processing.max_input_bytes is bounded by max_events, max_event_bytes, and max_attribute_bytes_per_event.
2 * processing.max_input_bytes is overflow-checked and bounded by max_name_bytes and max_context_bytes.
The same budget gate applies to sheetViews, sheetFormatPr, cols, pageMargins, pageSetup, and row spans; it does not convert an already-raised MCE or XML error into NotEligible.
evidence: all six metadata barrier resource-limit cases in crates/litchi-xlsx/src/raw/worksheet/selected/producer_metadata_tests.rs

findings.summary: The candidate preserves the existing semantic-event stream, raw x14ac observation, MCE dispatch, source-version fences, cancellation, XML depth/input/output limits, selected-cell dependency closure, and callback ordering.
semantic_guards: Raw observers and the active MCE scanner remain behind the existing stream limits and callback fences.
The source callback still falls back only for NotEligible; typed stream, XML, cancellation, and source-version errors retain their existing propagation path.

The baseline full-cell Store path does not validate the separate Worksheet::page_setup accessor; the selected route's pageSetup projection is therefore limited to inert lexical checks and does not add accessor validation to the baseline contract.

findings.summary: The baseline and candidate observable probes are identical over the retained corpus after normalizing only process-local SourceVersion.id fields.
The reviewed inventory is exactly the five frozen candidate paths, and each current identity matches candidate-freeze.json and the isolated quality-v9 source.

post_endpoint_checks: per-worksheet tolerance counts and clean reports

route_scope.note: The timed harness does not instrument selected-route eligibility. Raw scanner tests and the differential corpus provide correctness evidence; this review makes no runtime-route or physical-cold claim.

limitations: This is a source and semantic correctness review. It records quality-v9 and differential-corpus evidence but does not claim a speedup, memory reduction, allocator result, RSS result, runtime-route observation, or physical-cold eligibility.
Fresh release-build custody, paired timing, reduction, independent no-workload verification, and cleanup/freeze-plan checks remain separate measurement gates.

The differential comparator ignores only process-local SourceVersion.id fields; its 394 within-binary leg diagnostics are retained pre-existing differences and all baseline/candidate observable mismatches are zero.
The candidate source identities must continue to match candidate-freeze.json before measurement proceeds.
